lead: Almonds are soaked and ground to make almond milk, a plant-based beverage that can be used as a nondairy milk substitute.

procedure.text: Soak the almonds in the water overnight. They should swell and become supple.
Grind the soaked almonds and water in a blender. Blend in a pinch of salt and a few dates if desired.
Strain the almond mixture through a fine filter to remove the almond solids. Folded cheesecloth or a nut milk bag work well.
Use the almond milk immediately or chill.

sections.text: * Almond meal, which is made from the leftover chaff, can be used in smoothies and other recipes that call for almonds or almond flour.
